blockers.item: renderer routing capacity for a 4-label rank gap
blockers.detail: Every candidate that put all four ops/reconcile relations (q->ssh, q->jan, rec->prov, rec->db) between one pair of ranks was refused with 'no obstacle-safe route for ...; increase node/layer spacing' in both directions and at label widths from 13 to 20 characters. Routing only succeeded after the split moved rec->prov to v2 and rec->db out of v4; q->jan then fit in a 2-label gap. The result is a 4-view split (the maximum) in which the ops view carries 4 of its 6 relations' worth of content and v2 carries the two reconcile writes.
